scenario.name: 02 - Lead Qualification: Score & Route Leads
scenario.description: Watches for new leads in Airtable, verifies lead score, and routes them to the appropriate outreach sequence. Grade A leads get flagged for immediate personal contact. Grade B/C enter automated outreach. Grade D goes to nurture.

scheduling.note: Checks Airtable every 15 minutes for new leads with status 'New'

modules.name: Airtable - Search Records
modules.description: Find all leads with status 'New' that haven't been processed

modules.name: Router
modules.description: Route leads based on their grade

routes.name: Grade A — Immediate Personal Outreach
routes.description: High-value leads get personal attention within 1 hour

routes.name: Grade B — Priority Automated Outreach
routes.description: Good leads enter automated email sequence immediately

routes.name: Grade C — Standard Automated Outreach
routes.description: Average leads enter automated sequence with 4-hour delay

routes.name: Grade D — Nurture List
routes.description: Low-score leads go to nurture, no active outreach

modules.name: Airtable - Update Record (Grade A)
modules.description: Update lead status and flag for personal outreach
modules.note: Grade A leads should be contacted personally. The scenario 01 already sends an internal notification email.

modules.name: Airtable - Update Record (Grade B)
modules.description: Update lead and trigger automated outreach sequence

modules.name: Gmail - Send Email (Grade B Initial Outreach)
modules.description: Send initial outreach email immediately for Grade B leads

followedBy.description: Same as Grade B outreach (modules 5, 5b, 5c) but executed after delay

modules.description: Move to nurture list, no active outreach

setup_instructions: 1. Create this as a separate scenario in Make.com
2. Set the schedule to run every 15 minutes
3. Connect to the same Airtable base as Scenario 01
4. Configure the router filters with the lead score thresholds
5. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT_URL with your actual booking link
6. Paste the HTML content from gmail-templates/01-initial-outreach.html into the Gmail module
7. Test each route by creating test leads with different scores
